judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The image is the only content of a link to periodicos.capes.gov.br (the banner shows the '.periodicos.' logo of the CAPES Periódicos portal); its alt and title are 'Periodicos.jpg', so the link's accessible name is the file name, as the claim says. A file name used as the text alternative is the documented failure F30, and as a control the image needs a name that describes its purpose (H30); a screen reader announces the file name with its extension. The alt="" part of the advice would not fit a link image, but that is a suggested fix, not the claim. The snapshot held the lazy-load placeholder src while the screenshot shows the loaded banner; the live HTML has the same alt, so that difference does not touch the claim.
